primary_objective: normal-Neow-start A20 Ironclad Act1+Act2 joint clear probability
hypothesis: Reducing within-rollout dependence on an Act1-initialized critic with lambda=1 improves joint learning during horizon transfer relative to the completed lambda=.98 pilot.

parent.initialization: Match completed pilot: all model weights including critic; fresh Adam/RNG/workers/recurrent state; same reviewed weights-only native transition. Do not initialize from degraded 94M.

historical_training_control.limitation: One historical matched training seed, not a concurrent replicated randomized experiment; re-evaluate all arms on the same fresh development seeds and runtime.

unchanged: all actor and critic weights at initialization
reason_for_seed_reuse: Match the completed control initialization and seed stream; trajectories legitimately diverge after policy changes. New training seed replication follows only a promising result.
selection: Fixed experimental endpoint is primary. Periodic peak is diagnostic, not a substitute; do not search more checkpoints on confirmation after seeing its results.
cost_estimate: Completed pilot updates took 11.19h for 4.014M; allow roughly 14-18h total depending on node/evaluation, with measured preparation budget gate: training estimate*1.5 + evaluation reserve + elapsed preparation <=24h. A failed gate aborts submission/training rather than silently reducing budget.
success_criteria: Completed healthy budget; finite metrics/checkpoints; no backend/limit termination failures
Genuine ACT_2_CLEARED outcomes in both disjoint late windows [2M,3M) and [3M,4M+overshoot)
Fixed lambda=1 joint clear rate improves by at least .01 absolute over frozen90 and by at least .01 over matched historical lambda=.98 endpoint on fresh2048 confirmation
Both paired superiority comparisons pass exact two-sided McNemar with Holm correction across the two comparisons at family alpha=.05; report paired raw discordance and intervals, not p alone

outcomes.SUCCESS: Supports a second training-seed replication or bounded same-recipe extension, not immediate Act3 promotion.
outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: Positive but too small/uncertain gain; no automatic extension or holdout peeking. Reassess positive-example scarcity and natural-entry curriculum.
outcomes.NO_GAIN: No joint development gain. Stop this recipe; prioritize natural Act2-entry suffix training/critic adaptation with explicit new start-distribution and recurrent-state contracts.
outcomes.INCOMPLETE: Failed health or unfinished budget is an implementation/execution result, not evidence lambda cannot learn.

act1_reach_policy: Intermediate diagnostic and sample-efficiency signal only. No optimization/selection gate that vetoes a confirmed joint improvement; restoring reach alone is not success.
reserved_final_policy: Remain sealed through method development. Freeze one recipe/checkpoint selection rule before one final normal-start joint-clear evaluation; do not reuse it for tuning. Stock-game parity remains a separate transfer qualification.
remaining_preparation: Before GPU submission, complete bounded high-impact Act2 stock qualification and throughput profiling; see project-priorities.md
If rules/observation/action change, rebind identities and rebuild a matched training control rather than attribute environment fixes to lambda
Generate new runtime TOML and SHA-bound plan; keep completed pilot plan immutable
Run actual-parent warm-start/preflight and lambda=1 implementation/finite-update smoke checks
Implement identity-aware paired confirmation for models with intentionally different PPO lambda
Include all three evaluations and measured wall budget in one submission
Validate locally, commit/push GitHub, provide human-run NUS command
not_claimed: No lambda=1 optimizer update or server training was run in this analysis. Local collection-only probe establishes estimator behavior, not efficacy.

supersession.reason: Act2 audit confirmed production rule/RNG changes. Historical lambda=.98 run cannot be the strict single-variable training control in corrected environment.
supersession.required_next_decision: After qualification, design a matched corrected-environment control or explicitly preregister a new-recipe validation. No new NUS training in this audit.
